verdict.line: You lose if you stand still for his Q-W all-in before level 3; you win nearly every extended trade once Grog-Soaked Blade poison and Parrrley stack up.

brief.thesis: Volibear has zero movement abilities outside Q (Thundering Smash), so once you respect his 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s Q cooldown window you can kite freely with Parrrley and poison stacks while he's forced into dry autos. The whole lane is about denying him the Thundering Smash + Frenzied Maul burst window and then punishing him in every trade afterward.

theirWindow.when: Q is up and he's in range
theirWindow.what: He'll gain speed toward you and stun the first target he Attacks, then chain Frenzied Maul twice for the bonus damage and heal. Back off or pre-emptively trade poison before he closes the gap.

yourWindow.what: He has no gap-closer and no ranged tool besides Sky Splitter's 1200-range skillshot. Walk up, land Parrrley, and disengage before E lands — he cannot punish you for leaving.

start.why: Picked in 72.4% of these games at 52.3% win rate — the extra sustain and AD let you trade poison autos into his melee kit without losing the exchange.

boots.why: 54.9% win rate over 495 games; the lifesteal offsets Volibear's on-hit Frenzied Maul poke and his passive bonus magic damage from stacked attack speed.

core.why: First item in the 65.2%-winrate path over 293 games; mana sustain lets you spam Parrrley every 5s without running dry.
Second item in all three top build paths; the lethality and execute threshold close out trades he tries to Remove Scurvy out of.
Highest-winrate finisher (65.2% over 293 games); crit scaling punishes his lack of armor itemization early.

his passive-driven sustain or team healing is keeping him alive through your burst (57.4% win rate, 115 games)

runes.keystoneWhy: The burn stacks with Grog-Soaked Blade poison on every poke trade, and he has no dash to avoid the DoT once you land a Parrrley.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 90.1% of these games at 52.3% win rate — Ignite punishes his Frenzied Maul heal and closes out poison-stack kills before he can sustain through it.

playing.title: Trade only when Q is down
playing.detail: Track his Thundering Smash cooldown (10-12s depending on rank). Engage with Parrrley and auto resets while it's down; disengage the moment he can reach it again.

playing.title: Don't facecheck Frenzied Maul range
playing.detail: W is only 325 range but refreshes in 5s and heals him on the second cast. Never let him land it twice in one trade — pull out after the first mark.

playing.title: Zone with Cannon Barrage from level 6
playing.detail: His complete lack of a dash means Cannon Barrage's 20000 range threat denies CS and forces him off wave without any way to dodge or close distance on you.

playing.title: Respect Stormbringer dive timing after level 6
playing.detail: Per the OP.GG read, he has no gap-closer pre-6, but once he hits R he can leap 550 range and disable nearby towers temporarily — ward and track jungler position before over-extending.

playing.title: Use Remove Scurvy to void his stun
playing.detail: W clears crowd control instantly on a 18-22s cooldown. Save it specifically to cleanse Thundering Smash's stun so his all-in never fully connects.

playing.title: Poke, don't brawl, before level 6
playing.detail: His kit rewards sustained melee exchanges with heals and attack speed stacking. Parrrley from range and walk away rather than trading autos in his face.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own analysis layered on top of those numbers.
